data.name: Service Areas | Exterior Cleaning Across Melbourne | Prime Exteriors
data.description: Where Prime Exteriors works. Council areas and suburbs across Melbourne from a Dallas 3047 base, strongest through the northern corridor, with coverage east, west and inner city.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a travel fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not on normal residential and commercial work across the areas listed on this page. Where a job is both small and a long way out, we will tell you at quote stage that the travel is a real part of the cost, and usually suggest a way around it: bundling more surfaces into the visit, or booking it for a day when we are already out that way.

mainEntity.name: My suburb is not listed. Do you still come?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost certainly. The listed suburbs are the ones with enough measured demand to justify their own page, which is a different question from where we work. Send the suburb and what needs doing and you will get a straight answer rather than a maybe.

mainEntity.name: Which areas do you work in most?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The northern corridor, by a wide margin. The suburbs we name as our own are Craigieburn, Roxburgh Park, Donnybrook, Kalkallo, Greensborough, Eltham and Eltham North, out from the base at Dallas. Completed jobs are also on record in Mickleham, Diamond Creek, Coburg North, Brunswick West and Altona.

The east and west are regular rather than occasional, and the inner suburbs are mostly commercial.

mainEntity.name: Can you do several properties in the same area on one day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it is worth asking. Neighbours who book together, a street in a body corporate, or a property manager with several addresses in the same suburb all get a better rate than the same work booked separately, because the travel and set up are paid for once.

mainEntity.name: Do you work in regional Victoria?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not routinely. We are a Melbourne metropolitan business and we would rather say so than take a job we cannot service properly. For a large commercial or multi site job outside the metro area, ask and we will give you an honest answer about whether it makes sense.
